attchmntText: Akash Infra Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015In compliance with the requirements of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 as amended from time to time, Code of Practices & Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information adopted by the Company and circular issued by NSE vide its letter number NSE/CML/2019/11 dated 2nd April, 2019, it is hereby informed that the trading window for dealing in the Company's securities shall remain closed for the promoters, directors, senior managerial personnel along with their immediate relatives and other connected persons of the Company from 4th April, 2019 till 48 hours after the declaration of Audited Financial Results for the half-year and year ended on 31st March, 2019. The date of the Board Meeting to be held for approval of stated financial result shall be intimated separately.

Akash Infra Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Code of Conduct under SEBI(PIT) Reg., 2015: Amendment in Code of Practices & Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information
desc: Code of Conduct under SEBI(PIT) Reg., 2015
